A slightly dispersed, but closely grouped, hoard of twenty Early Medieval silver coins dating c. AD 880-923. A). Obverse legend reads +AL FR ED RE. Obverse shows a small cross patee. Reverse legend reads DIARV/ALD M<>, Moneyer is probably Diarwald (or possibly Diarvald). Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight 1.50g, diameter is 20.4mm, thickness is 1.0mm. B).
